sites.evidence_type: published tag insertion in the same loop or domain
sites.functional_impact_measured: Homozygous Cdh8^PA/PA mice show normal viability and fertility, confirming the tagged protein supports CDH8 function in vivo.
sites.rationale: The ledger clip reports a PA tag knocked into the endogenous Cdh8 locus in a full-length, membrane-anchored, surface-displayed context. The quote names no residue, so the position is topology-derived: CDH8 has a signal peptide spanning residues 1–29 (authoritative landmarks), a single extracellular N-terminus beginning at residue 30 (A), and an intracellular C-terminus (643–799), leaving insert_after_residue=29 as the sole extracellular terminal junction. Python verification confirms residue 29 = M and residue 30 = A. Normal viability and fertility of homozygous knock-in mice validates surface expression and functional tolerance. CRISPR/Cas9-mediated knock-in of a PA tag into the endogenous mouse Cdh8 locus, generating Cdh8-PA knock-in mice. The construct is full-length and membrane-anchored (surface-displayed CDH8). The ledger quote names no specific residue; CDH8 has a single extracellular terminus (mature N-terminus at residue 30, after signal peptide cleavage at residue 29), making insert_after_residue=29 the only topology-consistent placement for a surface PA tag.

sources.claim: Classic cadherin cell-cell adhesion molecules with self-organizing activities play roles in segregating distinct populations of cells at developing brain regions and/or boundaries. However, the protein dynamics of each cadherin subclass in the mouse embryonic brain is poorly described due to the low antigenicity. Here, we generate Cdh6-HA and Cdh8-PA tag knock-in (KI) mice by CRISPR/Cas9-mediated genome editing and establish Cdh6<sup>HA/HA</sup>; Cdh8<sup>PA/PA</sup>; Cdh11<sup>EGFP/EGFP</sup> triple tag KI homo mice with normal viability and fertility.

literature_notes: Only one ledger line (L1) is provided. It reports a PA tag knock-in at the endogenous Cdh8 locus with no residue number stated in the quote. The position is topology-derived as the mature N-terminus (after SP cleavage at residue 29) is the sole extracellular terminus. No internal loop insertions, C-terminal tags, or intracellular positions are reported in the ledger. The C-terminus (residues 643–799) is intracellular and therefore excluded. No abrogating insertions are reported.
